gate_purpose.name: gate_purpose
gate_purpose.default: 'We ask for your email address so we can tell you when this resource is updated and to understand who uses the Observatory. We do not share it.'

tagline.name: tagline
tagline.default: 'A policy and innovation network on responsible artificial intelligence'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Evidence, use cases, data and community for responsible AI in South and Southeast Asia.'

programme_note.name: programme_note
programme_note.default: 'The Asia AI4D Observatory is led by LIRNEasia with East-West Management Institute and JustJobs Network, with EngageMedia as a project partner. It is part of the Artificial Intelligence for Development (AI4D) programme, a partnership between IDRC and the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office.'

newsletter_consent_text.name: newsletter_consent_text
newsletter_consent_text.default: 'I agree to receive the Asia AI4D Observatory newsletter and occasional updates about its events and resources. I can unsubscribe at any time.'

download_consent_text.name: download_consent_text
download_consent_text.default: 'I agree that the Observatory may store my email address to send me updates about this resource and to report anonymised usage to its funders.'

registration_consent_text.name: registration_consent_text
registration_consent_text.default: 'I agree that the Observatory may store my details to manage my participation in this event and contact me about it.'

intro.name: intro
intro.default: 'The Asia AI4D Observatory maps how South and Southeast Asia design, govern and scale AI that is safe, rights-based, sustainable, inclusive and appropriate to context. Find use cases, mapping studies, data, people and opportunities in one place.'
